QuestInfo.name: Making a Sparkling Rock
QuestInfo.1: You meet Sophia in the General Store in Perion. She's working on her dream to be an alchemist. To make the sparkling rock, she says she needs #b50 squishy liquids, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs#k and #b1 Arcon's blood#k. Everything looks reasonable enough...wait, Arcon's blood?! Fortunately, Sophia knows where to get some. She says to have a chat with Manji, who's somewhere around Perion.
QuestInfo.2: Sophia told you that Manji has some Arcon's Blood, a key ingredient to make a sparkling rock.
